einzeiler: A grandmother investigates the Oklahoma City bombing after losing her two young grandsons.
kurzfassung: Kathy Sanders lost her two grandsons in the 1995 Oklahoma City bombing and has spent decades investigating inconsistencies in the official narrative. She claims numerous eyewitnesses placed Timothy McVeigh with unidentified accomplices, and that government informants and agencies had prior warnings. Despite her immense personal tragedy, Sanders ultimately chose a path of forgiveness, even befriending members of the perpetrators' families.
stichpunkte: Kathy Sanders lost her two grandchildren, Chase and Colton, in the April 19, 1995, bombing of the Alfred P. Murrah Federal Building.
The official government narrative maintains that Timothy McVeigh and Terry Nichols acted alone as a two-man conspiracy.
Sanders gathered witness statements indicating that multiple people saw McVeigh with other individuals before the attack.
Documents revealed that an ATF informant at Elohim City had warned her handlers about planned bombings prior to the attack.
Several federal employees and officials allegedly received high-alert warnings about potential terrorism in downtown Oklahoma City just before the blast.
Sanders documented numerous suspicious details, including uninvestigated foreign nationals and conflicting accounts from officials regarding bomb squads and elevators.
After years of overwhelming grief and the death of her husband, Sanders decided to pursue forgiveness and eventually corresponded with Terry Nichols and hosted his son.
Sanders has authored books detailing her independent investigation into what she views as a broader conspiracy surrounding the tragedy.

clips.hook: Seeing a bomb squad before the explosion
clips.text: A mother arriving at the daycare centre with her child reported seeing a bomb squad stationed outside the federal building prior to the detonation.
A fire station dispatcher confirmed to a visitor that staff had received a formal memorandum instructing them to maintain high alertness for terrorist activity in the area.

clips.hook: Demands for answers after the demolition
clips.text: Survivors confronted officials fiercely during the building demolition over the unexplained absence of federal agents who normally worked inside.
Elevator technicians disputed claims made by agency employees who alleged they had survived a free-fall from the top floor during the blast.

clips.hook: An unexpected welcome at the compound
clips.text: Compound residents responded with a standing ovation after the grieving family members introduced themselves during a gathering.
